text:
**The evidence does not establish whether the 2021 tree-cover loss was illegal.** Satellite data identified 81.3 hectares of loss, and 98% of that area was mapped as forest in 2020.

Uruguay’s 2021 forest map classified 68.1 hectares of the loss area as planted pine forest, none as native forest, and 13.2 hectares as outside mapped forest. The evidence does not include permits, applicable legal requirements, or the cause of the loss. Those would need to be checked before determining legality.
